new_alerts.thesis: UPGRADED from 7 to 8 (EARLY HIGH-PRIORITY WATCH -> HIGH-CONVICTION WATCH). Follow-through check confirms the news is real and well-corroborated: it is a genuine company press release (GlobeNewswire, 8:16am ET) independently reported by at least five separate outlets (MarketChameleon, StockTitan, SeekingAlpha, Investing.com, StockTwits) with consistent facts. Critically, the market reaction was clearly positive and volume-confirmed: OPTX traded up as much as ~24% intraday (high of $8.46 vs prior close $6.79) on volume roughly 3.2x its 90-day average (~1.32M vs ~409K), settling around $7.89-7.99 (+16-18%) by the after-hours snapshot. This is a real catalyst (Space Force/NRO satellite-optics order) with rising volume confirming genuine investor interest, not a spike-and-fade — the stock held most of its gains through the session. No firmer dollar figure for the specific order has emerged yet (only the aspirational '$100M+ backlog' framing), and no insider cash buying or analyst price-target action has followed as of this check, which is the main gap versus a clean 9-10 score. Small-cap fit is strong (~$318M market cap).
new_alerts.risks: No firm contract dollar value has been disclosed for the order itself — the '$100M+ backlog' language is forward-looking/aspirational, not a signed booked-backlog figure; no analyst coverage exists yet to validate the read-through; no insider cash buying has followed the news (large insider transaction today was a gift, not a purchase); a few hours of trading is not enough to confirm the move will hold — continue to monitor for follow-through in subsequent sessions rather than treating today's pop as fully de-risked.
